**Interpretation:** Candidate improves lockbox robustness (min) and matches/slightly exceeds lockbox mean, but fails on tuning stability and worsens worst-case drawdown. “PASS” here likely means it met your acceptance gates, but it’s not clearly dominating the champion on risk.
